claim: On November 22, 2023 the Kinesis Data Streams guide added support for sharing data streams across accounts, which lets a stream in one account be processed by an AWS Lambda function in another account through resource-based policies.
question: Since when can a Kinesis data stream be shared with another AWS account through a resource-based policy?
note: Current truth: kinesis-data-streams-resource-policy-grants-cross-account-access. Older exam questions may say cross-account access needs an assumed role.
